name: small_limit_coordinate_system
preamble:
module

public import LeanProofs.CoordinateSystem
public import Mathlib.Tactic

public section
universe u
open Set LeanProofs
statement:
theorem Search.small_limit_coordinate_system
    {κ : Cardinal.{u}} (hκ : Cardinal.IsInaccessible κ)
    {I X A : Type u} [Preorder I] [Nonempty I]
    [LinearOrder A] [Nonempty A] [NoMaxOrder A]
    [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X] [CompactSpace X]
    {Y : I → Type u} [∀ i, TopologicalSpace (Y i)] [∀ i, T2Space (Y i)]
    (p : (i : I) → X → Y i) (hsys : CompatibleCoordinates κ p)
    (R : Set X) (hsat : CoordinateSaturated p R)
    (hsmall : ∀ i, Cardinal.mk (p i '' R) < κ)
    (hA : Cardinal.mk A < κ) (H : A → Set X)
    (hH : Antitone H) (hc : ∀ a, IsCompact (H a))
    (hdisj : ∀ a, Disjoint (H a) R) (hbad : ∀ a, Bad p R (H a)) :
    Bad p R (⋂ a, H a)

tactics.text: exact bad_iInter_of_lt_cof p hsys.continuous R H hH hc (fun i => lt_of_lt_of_le (hsmall i) (Order.cof_le_cardinalMk A)) hbad
apply bad_iInter_of_lt_cof p hsys.continuous R H hH hc ?_ hbad
